{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Some Republicans believe America should turn away from the world.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Some Republicans oppose using U.S. armed forces as part of international solutions, even when regional conflicts threaten U.S. interests and values.",

"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Ensuring peace and security for Americans today means investing in building the global peace.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"More than 1 billion of the Earth's inhabitants live on less than $1 a day, inviting social dislocation, violence, and war.",
